verdict.rationale: Skyfire is fundamentally an API/SDK platform: agent operations (token creation, introspection, charging) are exposed via key-authenticated REST endpoints and an MCP server, both designed for programmatic/headless agent use with no UI dependency, and a live probe confirms the API is reachable and key-gated as documented. missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline example or GitHub Actions integration docs, and independent hands-on confirmation of running it in an automated pipeline.
